# Journal Recorder
Local Markdown notes, Python stdlib core. Optional private Git sync. Source and setup: https://github.com/GauravRatnawat/journal-recorder-agent#quick-start
Agent routes and manual use: https://github.com/GauravRatnawat/journal-recorder-agent#agent-support . APM ships manual skill and core, no hook activation.
Known secrets scrubbed before model, temp and save; reply and metadata scrub again. Bad policy blocks, missing policy uses builtins. Model failure skips entry, no raw fallback. Pattern scan cannot prove prose safe. Privacy: https://github.com/GauravRatnawat/journal-recorder-agent#privacy-filter
Manual summary needs no model CLI. Auto summary needs signed in Claude CLI and sends scrubbed text to model service. Codex generation needs explicit opt in and has weaker isolation. Local mode skips Git; private Git sends notes off machine and scans exact files and outgoing history. Failed sync keeps note, returns failure and leaves dedup unchanged. Model and Git details: https://github.com/GauravRatnawat/journal-recorder-agent#model-provider , https://github.com/GauravRatnawat/journal-recorder-agent#private-journal-path-and-git
Pins and past checks: https://github.com/GauravRatnawat/journal-recorder-agent#checks . Fake data and temp homes, no live model call or real hook change. Native app capture still needs live smoke. Renderer: https://github.com/GauravRatnawat/decision-ledger-setup
